templates.description_en: Glitch Digital - the outgoing scene glitches into horizontal displacement bands, RGB color channels splitting apart in digital corruption before snapping into the incoming scene
templates.prompt:
A seamless Glitch Digital transition effect between two scenes.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-3s] The first scene holds steady in a cinematic composition. The frame is stable, the lighting is balanced, and the subject is clearly visible, establishing the visual context that will be transformed by the transition.
[Shot 2] [3-6s] The outgoing scene glitches into horizontal displacement bands, rgb color channels splitting apart in digital corruption before snapping into the incoming scene. The transition executes with fluid, natural motion and cinematic quality. The camera movement and visual effect remain smooth and continuous, completing the handoff from the first scene to the second scene seamlessly.

overall_soundscape: digital glitch stutters with electronic zaps. No dialogue, no music in the soundscape layer.

non_diegetic_music: a glitchy techno beat with data drops, synced to the rhythm of the transition for a polished editorial feel.
